objective: Take up backlog B6 (G15 with G4), after the owner asked on 2026-11-09 whether the learning line had been left: can learning carry information that no change of state can? On the class-forced lattice tori of COUNT-SURFACES-20261107-001A (the two Fano tori and the thin tori of even index up to 40 points), with the state held fixed and sign changes made only at the dissonance (A26), split the forced pair, carry the holes into the over-agreeing face, and read whether every resolving walk winds around a handle, which classes it reaches, its cost against the systole, and whether a local rule finds it. Expectations pre-registered in research/LEARN-HANDLES-20261109-001/preregistration.md.
status: Complete 2026-11-09: learning carries what no change of state can, in handles. Only surfaces of Euler characteristic 0 can be free of dissonance; on a torus whose Kasteleyn law is in a class no state satisfies the least dissonance is one violated line and one fully agreeing face, learning at the dissonance with the state fixed resolves it leaving no even face, and every resolution, whatever the state does, winds around a handle into another class (proved; 96,732 walks checked on the two Fano tori and 57 thin tori up to 40 points). Computed: cheapest walks meet the cycle bound exactly; a local rule with an outside distance resolved all 9,608 starts, against the pre-registered expectation. The sphere's local rule held one size past. Recommendation Continue (B61, a native target for learning).
stop_rule: Stop when every class-forced least state is resolved by a walk that winds, into every other class, with the local rule and costs read, or at the first least state no walk resolves.
title: Learning in handles
